title: AI Loop State Schema
description: Schema for tracking AI coding task state through the verification workflow

taskId.description: Unique identifier for the task (UUID or format: task-YYYYMMDD-hhmmss)

description.description: Detailed description of the task and its requirements

status.description: Current state of the task in the workflow

baseCommit.description: Git commit SHA that serves as the baseline for changes

targetBranch.description: Branch where changes will be committed

filesModified.description: List of files that have been modified during this task

filesCreated.description: List of files that have been created during this task

filesDeleted.description: List of files that have been deleted during this task

verifiedTests.description: Whether matching tests have been added or updated

verifiedDocs.description: Whether documentation has been updated to match code changes

verifiedNeutrality.description: Whether files pass neutrality checks (no AI markers, no IDE metadata)

verifiedNoDuplication.description: Whether no new duplication has been introduced

retryAttempts.description: Retry attempt tracking (primary implementation tracked separately via primaryImplementationStatus)

primaryImplementationAttempt.description: Count of PRIMARY_IMPLEMENTATION_ATTEMPT executions (0 = not started, 1 = executed; not a retry, tracked separately)

transientRetry.description: Count of TRANSIENT_RETRY retries for the current operation

flakyTestRerun.description: Count of FLAKY_TEST_RERUN reruns for the current test

lastRetryType.description: Type of the last retry operation (null if primary implementation or no retries)

lastRetryReason.description: Description of why the last retry occurred

retryLimitsExceeded.description: List of retry types for which limits have been exceeded (requires human approval). Primary implementation exceeding 1 is a plan revision need, tracked separately.

primaryImplementationStatus.description: Status of primary implementation attempt (separate from retries)

primaryImplementationFailureReason.description: Reason for primary implementation failure (if status is 'failed')

verifierRejection.description: Whether a verifier has rejected the result (no automatic retries allowed)

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the task state was created

updatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the task state was last updated

initiator.description: Name of the person or system that initiated the task
